titles.ja: SFCDFクロスドメイン移送研究1 — G3-04 C1・C6のfresh domain一般化可能範囲と反例境界のprospective検証
titles.en: SFCDF Cross-Domain Transfer Study 1 — Prospective fresh-domain generalization and counterexample-boundary testing of G3-04 C1 and C6

forbidden: change C6 population because of C1 result
change C1 population because of C6 result
change seed allocation because of either result
change selection rule because of either result
change threshold or multiplicity because of either result
drop either claim after fresh access

identityContract.rawStateSha256: SHA-256 of stable JSON over rawStateFields only
identityContract.fullSourceTrajectorySha256: SHA-256 of canonical move identity keys joined by newline for the full generated trajectory
identityContract.openingPrefixSha256: SHA-256 of the first 16 canonical move identity keys joined by newline; if trajectory length <16 the source is ineligible

sourcePolicies.selection: floor(u * legalMoveCount) from all legal moves at every ply
evaluate authoritative immediate capture-event seed count for every legal move, retain the minimum-count pool, then choose floor(u * poolCount)

rootFamilies.mtajiRoot: first nonterminal phase=mtaji state at ply >=40

frozenDomain.experimentalUnit: one fresh source trajectory yielding one paired Namua/Mtaji root pair under one frozen policy x root-family cell
frozenDomain.phaseContrast: Mtaji minus Namua within the same source-trajectory/root-family pair
frozenDomain.scope: only the four frozen cells; no whole-Bao universal-law inference

C6.formula: sum(treeNodeOccurrences[d], d=0..5) / count(distinct authoritative RAW states across d=0..5)

cellEligibility: source policy and root family match the frozen cell
both phase roots exist and satisfy the frozen root contract
source has at least 16 canonical moves
all applicable upstream and within-study identity firewalls pass
depth-5 preflight remains inside frozen per-root resource ceilings
selectionContract.selectionKey: SHA-256('SFCDFT|' + stageId + '|' + policyId + '|' + rootFamilyId + '|' + seed + '|' + fullSourceTrajectorySha256 + '|' + namuaRawStateSha256 + '|' + mtajiRawStateSha256)
selectionContract.ordering: ascending selectionKey within each frozen cell

stage1CompatibilityContract.perSelectedRoot: compute production and independent RAW depth-5 measurement and require exact canonical agreement; persist identity/support and measurement digest only

formalInference.tests: C1 and C6 separately in each of four frozen policy x root-family cells
formalInference.zeroHandling: remove exact zero differences for the sign test but retain zeros in coverage accounting
formalInference.exactTwoSidedSignTest: p = min(1, 2 * P[Binomial(n,0.5) <= min(k,n-k)]) where n is nonzero-pair count and k is positive-sign count
formalInference.multipleTesting: Holm step-down across all 8 frozen claim x cell test slots
formalInference.nonEstimableSlotForMultiplicity: assign p=1 for Holm bookkeeping; retain NON-ESTIMABLE label

directionRule.SFCDFT-C1: same-direction iff positive-count > negative-count; opposite-direction iff negative-count > positive-count; tie=no-direction
directionRule.SFCDFT-C6: same-direction iff negative-count > positive-count; opposite-direction iff positive-count > negative-count; tie=no-direction

claimDecisionMapping.TECHNICAL-INVALID: any integrity/provenance/implementation violation affecting the formal stage; not a scientific negative
claimDecisionMapping.COUNTEREXAMPLE-BOUNDARY-DETECTED: at least one estimable cell for the claim has Holm PASS and dominant direction opposite to the frozen G3-04 direction
claimDecisionMapping.GENERALIZES-WITHIN-FROZEN-DOMAIN: all four cells for the claim are estimable, all four have Holm PASS, and all four dominant directions equal the frozen G3-04 direction
claimDecisionMapping.NON-ESTIMABLE: no opposite Holm-pass cell exists, and at least one required cell fails frozen support/definedness/nonzero/resource estimability without integrity failure
claimDecisionMapping.NOT-CONFIRMED: full required domain is estimable, no opposite Holm-pass cell exists, but the all-four same-direction Holm-pass criterion is not met

stoppingRule.normal: process every frozen source slot in the authorized stage, then stop; no result-based early stopping
stoppingRule.technical: stop immediately on integrity failure or hard resource breach
stoppingRule.support: insufficient support after the frozen source slots are exhausted is NON-ESTIMABLE; do not extend seeds

afterAnyFreshStageAccess: resource-ceiling relaxation to rescue a scientific result

technicalInvalidConditions: source-code or prereg binding mismatch after stage authorization
forbidden seed/trajectory/prefix/root identity overlap under the applicable firewall
root contract mismatch admitted into selected population
execution interruption after fresh access that prevents complete auditable stage artifact

executionContract.executionInterruptionAfterFreshAccess: fail closed, quarantine consumed stage namespace, no full scientific rerun
executionContract.preExecutionRequirement: bind exact production/independent implementation hashes and runbook hash in a separate stage authorization before fresh access

independentVerification.measurement: production and independent implementations must agree exactly on canonical depth-5 RAW measurement for every selected root
independentVerification.statistics: formal sign counts, exact p-values, Holm decisions, and claim mapping must be independently recomputed from the frozen formal artifact

stage0RequiredChecks: G3-04 and legacy G4-01 identity-firewall loader checks
exact sign-test and Holm fixture checks
interpretationLimits: no claim of opening-prefix disjointness from legacy G4-01 Stage 1R
no claim of complete trajectory/root/prefix auditability for interrupted G4-01 Stage 1
